notes.title: Beta State
notes.content:
Hello all!

As most of bugs are fixed now and all basic features are IN game is now moving to BETA.

From now we will focus on gameplay and content, working on products prices / usages and visual tweaks.

We will also add or remove features like "clan servers" or "commands lines" according to players feebacks and global "needs".

See you soon and please feel free to post suggestions or commands either on discord or in steam discussions.
